methods.label: Subtract consecutive totals
methods.explanation:
The mean tells us the total once we know how many terms it averages. Let \(a_n\) be the \(n\)th term and \(S_n\) the sum of the first \(n\) terms. For every positive integer \(n\),
\[
\frac{S_n}{n}=n,\qquad S_n=n^2.
\]
For \(n\ge2\), subtracting the total of the first \(n-1\) terms removes every earlier term and leaves only \(a_n\). Therefore
\[
\begin{aligned}
a_n&=S_n-S_{n-1}\\
&=n^2-(n-1)^2\\
&=[n-(n-1)][n+(n-1)]\\
&=2n-1.
\end{aligned}
\]
The original condition gives \(a_1=1\), so this formula also holds at \(n=1\). Hence
\[
a_{2008}=2\cdot2008-1=\boxed{4015},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
